standard_prerequisites.name: fppf descent for morphisms and opens
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Descent on Spaces lemmas fpqc-universal-effective-epimorphisms, open-fpqc-covering, descending-property-finite (cross-chapter, named block)
standard_prerequisites.use: Glues the pair (a, Z) from covering data and descends finiteness.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaf presentation of an algebraic space
standard_prerequisites.use: T = U/R as the fppf quotient sheaf.

standard_prerequisites.name: Yoneda
standard_prerequisites.use: A pair over U gives a transformation h_U -> (X/Y)_fin.

core_obligations: Glue a T-point from compatible pairs on an fppf cover: a via the effective-epimorphism lemma, Z via the open-descent lemma, finiteness via fpqc locality.

For (2) construct both directions: a transformation restricts to a pair over U with matching s- and t-pullbacks, glued back over T; conversely a pair yields a transformation by Yoneda which coequalizes h_t, h_s and factors through the quotient sheaf.
Verify the two constructions are mutually inverse (this verification is omitted in the source and is carried as an explicit obligation).
proof_roadmap: Descent gluing, then the two-way Yoneda/quotient-sheaf correspondence, then the inverse check as a stated obligation.
difficulty_reason: The gluing argument and the quotient-sheaf factorization are substantive; the inverse check is mechanical but non-vacuous.
